name: Tachibana Kaju
source:
The long lost osananajimi (maybe) that has amnesia. Self-proclaimed “reliable oneesan” of the family but despite the long silky black hair she is a natural klutz. Favorite items being healthy foods, there are times when the dorm’s kitchen may have seen better days. In a few words: slow, my pace, and assets.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/07/21/sukima-zakura-to-uso-no-machi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real identity is Tachibana Fuwari (橘 ふわり). Having lost her memory, she only remembered the name of "[url=https://vndb.org/c77583]Kaju[/url]" and the role of "onee-chan" and she rebuilt her personality with these elements.[/spoiler]
